Short title and commencement

ACT LIV OF 1975
ACT LIV OF 1975
INSURANCE
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1975
An act further to
amend the Insurance Act, 1938
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 26th July 1975]
The following Act of Parliament
received the assent of the President on the 21st July 1975, and is hereby
published for general information:-
1. Short title and
commencement.----(1) This Act may be called the Insurance (Amendment) Act,
1975.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

General amendment, Act IV of 1938

ACT LIV OF 1975
ACT LIV OF 1975

(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1975
An act further to
amend the Insurance Act, 1938
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 26th July 1975]
The following Act of Parliament
received the assent of the President on the 21st July 1975, and is hereby
published for general information:-
2. General amendment, Act IV
of 1938.----In the Insurance Act, 1938 (IV of 1938), hereinafter referred
to as the said Act, for the words "Central Govern ment", wherever
occurring, the words "Federal Government" shall be sub stituted.

Amendment of section 29, Act IV of 1938

ACT LIV OF 1975
ACT LIV OF 1975
INSURANCE
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1975
An act further to
amend the Insurance Act, 1938
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 26th July 1975]
The following Act of Parliament
received the assent of the President on the 21st July 1975, and is hereby
published for general information:-
3. Amendment of section 29,
Act IV of 1938.------In the said Act, in sec tion 29, in subsection (8),-
(a) in clause (c),-
(i) for sub-clause (iii) the
following shall be substituted, namely:---
"(iii) the loan does not
exceed such amount as may be prescribed and is subject to such conditions,
including conditions as to interest and the time allowed for its payment, as
may be prescribed;"; and
(ii) after sub-clause (iii)
substituted as aforesaid, the following new sub clause shall be added,
namely:-
"(iv) the aggregate of such
loans in respect of the life insurance business of the insurer does not exceed
such amount as may be prescribed ;"; and
(b) in clause (d),-
(i) in the proviso, after the
word "insurer", the words "other than the State Life Insurance
Corporation of Pakistan" shall be inserted and for the full-stop at the
end a colon shall be substituted ; and
(ii) after the proviso amended as
aforesaid, the following further proviso shall be added, namely:-
"Provided further that, in
respect of the life insurance business of an inserter, the total amount
outstanding in respect of temporary advances made on or after the 1st January
1975, shall not exceed at any time one-tenth of one per cent. of the life
insurance fund in the case of employees on the one hand and one-tenth of one
per cent. of the life insurance fund in the case of insurance agents and
employers of agents on the other.".

4. Amendment of section 40-A,
Act IV of 1938.---In the said Act, in section 40-A,-
(a) in subsection (1), in the
proviso,-
(i) in clause (c), after the
semi-colon at the end, the word "and" shall be added;
(ii) for clauses (d), (e) and (f
) the following shall be substituted, namely:-
"(d) the proportion of
business not lapsing out of the business procured by the agent to the business
so procured."; and
(b) in subsection (3-A), in the
proviso, for clauses (d), (e), (f ), (g) and (h) the following shall be
substituted, namely:-
"(d) the proportion of
business not lapsing out of the business procured by the employer of agents to
the business so procured ; and
(e) the number of employers of
agents intervening between the insurer and the insurance agents.".
